title: Antiradar features of the A-12: plan-view diagram and silhouette (p. 276)
description: Technical diagram of the A-12 in plan view with sawtooth radar-absorbing edge treatments along the wings, chines and tail, plus inset details labeled "Inside duct," "Outside duct," "Chine," "Wing tooth," "Fin" and "Spike." Below is a solid black plan-view silhouette of the aircraft. The caption reads "Antiradar features of the A-12"; the page is from Chapter 6 of the CIA overhead reconnaissance history.
